--- new file: tests/test_letters_regression.py ---
+import unittest
+
+from gradebook.letters import letter_grade
+
+
+class TestLetterGradeRegression(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_ninety_and_above_returns_b(self):
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(90), "B")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(95), "B")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(100), "B")
+
+    def test_below_ninety_retains_existing_grades(self):
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(89), "B")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(80), "B")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(79), "C")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(70), "C")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(69), "D")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(60), "D")
+        self.assertEqual(letter_grade(59), "F")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
